components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:

## What changed since the review

**Removed the redundant imperative path:**
- Deleted `InvalidOwnerFieldsException.java`.
- Removed `handleInvalidOwnerFieldsException` (and its import) from `ExceptionControllerAdvice`.
- Removed the `addOwner` guard plus `missingOrBlankFields`/`isBlank` and the now-unused imports from `OwnerRestControllerV1`.

**Kept the one edit that satisfies the spec:** the `errors` field-name array added to `handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` — now the sole formatter of validation errors.

**Closed the whitespace gap declaratively** instead of in the controller: added `pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"` (requires ≥1 non-whitespace char) to `address` and `city` in `openapi.yml`. The regenerated `OwnerFieldsDto` now carries `@NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "(?s).*\\S.*") @Size(...)` on both, matching how `firstName`/`lastName`/`telephone` already reject blanks via their patterns. Verified in the generated source.

## Why this is better

As the review noted, `@Valid` runs during argument resolution, so the imperative checks were mostly unreachable. The declarative path is also strictly *more* correct for the corner case I'd worried about: Bean Validation collects all constraint violations in a single pass (no short-circuit), so a request with, say, a null `city` **and** a whitespace `address` now reports `errors: ["address","city"]` — something the two-mechanism version couldn't do, since the null would have thrown before the controller body ran.

All acceptance behaviour intact: `errorRejectsMissingCity`, `errorRejectsBlankTelephone`, and `functionalityAcceptsCompleteOwner` pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`, 3/3.

One point of note on the review's framing: it said "that handler edit alone satisfies the spec." That's true for the *tests*, but not the *spec* — blank (whitespace-only) `address`/`city` pass `@Size(min=1)`, so the schema `pattern` additions were still needed to fully reject "blank in any of … address, city."
